scope: Technical review of five authored composition-view candidates, the existing actual backend-loader proof and their already reviewed source bindings. No active curriculum writes.

reviewMethod.ownChecksExecuted: Read five before/candidate files and active preconditions; independently recalculate all 96 proof rows, canonical reference resolution and exact ordinary-reference deltas; read eight public source-extraction records and eight runtime source components; verify twenty declared independent A/B receipt bindings.
reviewMethod.backendRunner: Existing actual runner and output reviewed; this reviewer did not rerun the Java probe.
reviewMethod.scienceReview: No new scientific description, positive-understanding or image review performed; genuine existing scientific receipts were checked for byte integrity only.
reviewMethod.preApplicationObservation: All five active hashes were observed to equal the guard before hashes during the completed independent review. Root application may occur before this receipt is written. Current state is recorded per operation.
